options: A living organism that is very old
Preserved remains or traces of a past organism
A type of rock with no organic material
A modern animal without a skeleton
optionsAf: ’n Lewende organisme wat baie oud is
Bewaarde oorblyfsels of spore van ’n vorige organisme
items.explain: Fossils are preserved remains or traces of organisms that lived in the past.
items.explainAf: Fossiele is bewaarde oorblyfsels of spore van organismes wat in die verlede gelewe het.

items.q: Why are fossils of marine animals found on mountains?
items.qAf: Waarom word fossiele van seediere op berge gevind?
options: The mountains were once under the sea
optionsAf: Die berge was eens onder die see
items.explain: Sediments laid down under the sea became rock, which was later uplifted into mountains.
items.explainAf: Sedimente wat onder die see afgelê is, het rots geword, wat later tot berge opgelig is.

items.q: Fossils in a lower rock layer are normally ____ than fossils in a layer above it.
items.qAf: Fossiele in ’n laer rotslaag is gewoonlik ____ as fossiele in ’n laag daarbo.
items.explain: Under the law of superposition, lower layers are older.
items.explainAf: Volgens die superposisiewet is laer lae ouer.

options: Organisms change their traits to suit their needs
Individuals with favourable traits survive and reproduce more
All organisms in a population are identical
Mutations happen only when the environment changes
optionsAf: Organismes verander hul eienskappe om by hul behoeftes te pas
Individue met gunstige eienskappe oorleef en plant meer voort
Alle organismes in ’n populasie is identies
Mutasies kom slegs voor wanneer die omgewing verander
items.explain: Individuals with advantageous variations survive and pass those traits on, so the population changes over time.
items.explainAf: Individue met voordelige variasies oorleef en gee daardie eienskappe aan hul nageslag oor, sodat die populasie oor tyd verander.

items.q: A beetle population is mostly green. A bird eats mainly brown beetles. After many generations, what is most likely?
items.qAf: ’n Kewerpopulasie is meestal groen. ’n Voël eet hoofsaaklik bruin kewers. Wat is na baie generasies die mees waarskynlik?
items.explain: Green beetles survive better, so more of them reproduce and pass on the green trait.
items.explainAf: Groen kewers oorleef beter, dus plant meer van hulle voort en gee die groen eienskap oor.

items.q: Why do bacteria become resistant to an antibiotic over time?
items.qAf: Waarom word bakterieë mettertyd bestand teen ’n antibiotikum?
options: The antibiotic causes mutations in every bacterium
Bacteria pass all traits to new cells
optionsAf: Bakterieë kies om bestand te word
Die antibiotikum veroorsaak mutasies in elke bakterie
Bakterieë gee alle eienskappe aan nuwe selle oor
items.explain: Resistant bacteria survive the antibiotic and reproduce, so resistance spreads through the population.
items.explainAf: Bestande bakterieë oorleef die antibiotikum en plant voort, sodat weerstand deur die populasie versprei.
